class.name: JRPGGoldWindow
class.brief_description: The gold window: the party's gold and the currency unit.
class.description: Shows the party's [member gold] with the [member currency_unit] after it, at the top right of the screen, as a message's [code]\$[/code] code asks for ([signal JRPGMessageWindow.gold_window_requested]) and menus show it. The text uses the [JRPGMessageWindow]'s font, font size and line height, unless the window's own theme overrides set them. Authority: client. It shows the gold the game state holds (the server's, online).

method.name: show_gold
method.description: Shows [param gold] and [param unit] at the top right of the screen, opening the window.

members.member: The currency unit, shown after the amount in the system label color.

constants.constant: The text color of the currency unit, in [method JRPGMessageWindow.get_default_text_colors].
